applicableAreas: All four transformer pad locations on site
findings.comment: Minimum 5-foot clearances from transformer pads to buildings, structures, and building foundations cannot be verified. Electrical plan Sheet 21 shows four transformer pad locations but provides no dimensions, clearance measurements, or scale-based verification of compliance with UCM minimum clearance requirements.

applicableAreas: West-central and southwest transformer pads, which are adjacent to building walls
findings.comment: Minimum 12-foot horizontal clearance from transformer pads to windows, doors, or ventilating ducts cannot be verified when lateral separation is less than 5 feet or window/door is less than 12 feet from grade. Building elevations are not provided to show window/door locations relative to transformer pad locations and heights.

applicableAreas: Northwest transformer pad, which is adjacent to 5-foot concrete sidewalk
findings.comment: Minimum 2-foot clearance from back of sidewalks to transformer pads cannot be verified. Electrical plan shows transformer adjacent to 'Construct 5\' Concrete Sidewalk' on Sheet 21, but the distance between the sidewalk back and pad is not dimensioned.

Minimum 20-foot horizontal/radial clearance from fire escapes or stairs serving as fire exits for oil-filled equipment cannot be verified. Fire protection plan does not show fire escape locations dimensioned relative to transformer pad locations. Equipment type (oil-filled vs. dry) is not specified on electrical plan.

applicableAreas: All four transformer pad locations on site
findings.comment: Hot-stick use area (access door side) minimum 10-foot clearance to open area or adjacent building/structure cannot be verified. Access door orientation is not identified on the electrical plan for any transformer pad. Without door orientation and clearance dimensions, compliance cannot be assessed.

Minimum 5-foot clearance from fire hydrants to transformer pads cannot be verified. Fire protection plan shows private fire hydrant on site, but its location is not dimensioned relative to transformer pad locations.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations with nearby trees, particularly northwest transformer
findings.comment: Trees within 10 lateral feet of pad-mounted equipment cannot be verified as utility-compatible per ECM Appendix F. The electrical plan shows one transformer under tree canopy with a callout 'Tree Well need to look up approp. detail', but the appropriate detail is not provided. Tree species identification and Appendix F utility compatibility verification are not demonstrated on the landscape or tree list sheets for transformer proximity.

Shrub and low-lying vegetation clearances from transformer pads cannot be verified. Required minimum 10 lateral feet from access door side and 5 lateral feet from other sides are not documented with measurements. No access door orientation is shown, and no planting distance dimensions relative to transformer locations are provided.

applicableAreas: Potential tree locations within 20 lateral feet of transformer pads
findings.comment: Root barrier specifications cannot be verified. Required root barriers (minimum 4 feet deep, installed 5 feet from underground electric equipment) are not detailed or specified for any trees shown within 20 lateral feet of transformer pad locations. Sheet 37 may have landscape details, but no root barrier specifications are referenced for transformers.
Minimum 5-foot clearance from light poles to transformer pads cannot be verified. Electrical plan does not dimension distances between light poles and transformer pad locations.

Minimum 15-foot clearance from fire lanes to transformer pads cannot be verified. Fire protection plan shows fire lanes are the internal circulation aisles, and transformer pads appear adjacent to these circulation areas, but distances are not dimensioned.

applicableAreas: Between all four transformer pad locations
findings.comment: Minimum 5-foot clearance between multiple transformer pads cannot be verified. Four transformer pads are shown on the electrical plan, but distances between them are not dimensioned.

Minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance from transformer pads to water lines cannot be verified. Electrical plan Sheet 21 shows water (W) lines in proximity to transformer pads, but distances are not dimensioned. Without measurements, compliance with UCM § 2.9.1.B.2 cannot be confirmed.

Minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance from transformer pads to wastewater lines cannot be verified. Electrical plan Sheet 21 shows wastewater (WW) lines in close proximity to multiple transformer pads, particularly bracketing the northwest and west-central pads, but clearance distances are not dimensioned.

Minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance from transformer pads to storm drain lines cannot be verified. Electrical plan Sheet 21 shows storm drain (SD) lines parallel to transformer pad locations, but distances are not dimensioned.

Minimum 12-inch horizontal and vertical clearance from transformer pads to other underground utilities cannot be verified. Underground electrical lines are shown connecting to transformer pads, and multiple utilities are shown on the electrical plan, but no clearance dimensions are provided.

Cross-section drawings showing vertical clearances in access paths with overhead structures are not provided. Transformer locations are shown on site plan, but no cross-section sheets demonstrate vertical clearances from overhead structures, parking garages, or enclosed areas to pad locations.

Grading plan drainage slopes relative to transformer pads cannot be verified. Equipment type (oil-filled vs. dry) is not specified on electrical plan. For oil-filled equipment, liquid flow must be directed away from building; this requirement cannot be assessed without knowing equipment type and reviewing drainage slopes.

Transformer pads may be located in or conflict with prohibited easements (drainage, water, sewer, overhead electric easements) without documented AE Design written approval. Easement locations are noted on site plan but not dimensioned relative to transformer pad locations; compliance cannot be verified.

Transformer easements are not shown on the site plan or plat. Required easements around transformer pads for Austin Energy accessibility are not depicted. Easement width adequate for AE Design accessibility requirements cannot be verified.

Electrical routing from transformer to meter 100% on private property cannot be verified. Electrical plan shows routing to electrical meters on building walls, but property line locations are not dimensioned relative to routing paths. Right-of-way routing cannot be ruled out.

Transformer pad dimensions do not match or reference Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets. No pad dimensions (length, width, depth) are shown on the electrical plan. No AE Design-approved detail sheets for the specified service type (single-phase or three-phase) are referenced or provided. Service type determination is not documented.

applicableAreas: All four transformer pad locations, particularly those adjacent to parking and circulation areas
findings.comment: Required 4-inch minimum diameter galvanized rigid metal post (bollards) placement cannot be verified. Electrical plan shows transformer pads located within or very near circulation aisles and parking areas, but no bollard details or specifications are shown. Without dimensioned distances to parking/traffic areas and without bollard detail sheets, compliance with the 4-foot proximity requirement cannot be verified.
